summary: Fractal UI agent rows, status, duration and time helpers, and resource cards no longer set native title tooltips that duplicated the custom hover cards. Each former title string stays available as an accessible description (hidden span plus aria-describedby). Row buttons are named exactly by their visible title, with the full reported facts as the description, and row text uses the fgSoft token instead of a separate sidebar grey.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Presentation and accessibility only. sidebarRowAccessibleName is a new additive export; existing exports are unchanged.
